set.body: Create modules/surface with shared/jvm/js layout, README, sbt crossProject entries, root aggregation, and test aliases. Acceptance: surfaceJVM/test and surfaceJS/test exist and compile with placeholder tests; build.sbt changes are narrow; no unrelated atlas/group/build-hygiene work is swept in. Likely paths: build.sbt, README.md, modules/surface/README.md, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala, modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala.
